value: Professional contractor James Alves and his wife Amy turned to cannabis after construction dipped following the real estate crash: a collective, then a farm (Humboldt AF Cannabis), then two delivery services, Humboldt's Magic Bus and Chico Magic Bus.
Like most enterprises in this unpredictable industry, they had to close the doors and re-evaluate.
The company dates its community service from this year.
Microbusiness established at 1131 Broadway, Eureka: manufacturing, distribution and local delivery first, then the dispensary.
City approves an outdoor consumption patio for the Arcata site (non-smoking use).
Arcata retail license issued (C10-0001327-LIC, adult-use and medicinal).
Second store opens at 460 I St, Arcata, in the former V&N Burger Bar building.
First-anniversary party: DJ, vendors, games, spin-the-wheel, in-store specials.
Arcata City Council legalizes on-site smoking.
Arcata Planning Commission unanimously approves an outdoor smoking lounge on the patio.

value: Built by James, a professional contractor; layout inspired by the TV show Bar Rescue, designed from the customer's point of view
Slat boards with vibrant colors and floating lights from the ceiling
Courtyard lounge with covered gazebos and fireplaces accentuated by a built-in rock waterfall
A great place to commune before a walk at the local Arcata Marsh
This used to be the V&N Burger Bar
Donates to parks and recreation programs, including the FFA
Today the courtyard welcomes edibles and THC drinks (non-smoking).
Nov 10, 2026: Planning Commission unanimously approved an outdoor smoking lounge for products bought in the store.
Pitched as calm and clean: daily litter sweeps and an air scrubber; mellower than the competition, like eating outside at a restaurant.
Jolly Giant Creek runs beside the lot; the Arcata Marsh is nearby.
